note: Robot abilities (design brief §13). Assembly parts are the robot's items in robot_parts.json; a robot activates when every part is installed at its repair-bay station. Distances/heights in metres, speeds in m/s, times in seconds. Player walk speed is 3.0, eye height 1.62.

retrobot.name: Retrobot
retrobot.comment: He picks up only parts lying no higher than reach_height and no larger than max_item_size (≈ his own size). Destinations above reach_height get the part dropped in a small pile on the floor in front of them (still unsorted) — a later robot (Hoverbot) handles high storage.
retrobot.personality: Earnest, enthusiastic, slightly clumsy. Picks up one part at a time, already knows where it belongs, and chugs it there.
